note: The edge's OWN three routes, and the only ones it may declare: /health is the LB probe, /auth/me is 'who is this key', and /internal/mcp/taint is where the MCP reports the privacy label of a read it made directly (D6: the edge marks the worker's session in Redis; the unit is read from the identity the edge resolved). All three are identity-only and forward nothing downstream, which is why they carry no scope — an empty `scopes` is a DECLARATION of that, never an omission. /auth/me carries `mcp_reentry`: the MCP asks it, with a worker's token on its re-entry, before it spends the deployment's operator key on an `auth: admin` tool.
